label: Cheapest-route packing of the God-existence leaf in the fork route
summary: Issue #1926 phase 0. QUESTION: can the box K node cdf897a8 (NecessaryRootBoxK) of the cheapest root route 8df2faad be derived from the quarta-via classical GOD_4 root da3facd6 (NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt), so that the route no longer depends on the bare leaf b9816722 (RootFactsForBearer, which unfolds to RootFacts = ActualRoot and IsGod and IsTheOneGod and HasClassicalAttributes, that is, the existence and attributes of GOD_4 as one leaf)? TYPE CHECK: no mismatch. Both declarations take the same Signature sigma, the same Profile m on sigma.Being and the same world w. The necessity clause of da3facd6 is NecessaryAt m.ontic w n (inside PerfectRootAt), and BoxExistsAt m.ontic w n is the same proposition over the same frame m.ontic.frame (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl). ActualRoot is the same NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot in both; IsTheOneGod sigma.IsGod is the fourth of the nine case predicates; HasClassicalAttributes is the same signature field. The relation CN of the box K node is unused by that sense. Both nodes carry the single sense NECESSARY_2 and GOD_4 (truth semantics preflight: no unbridged mixing). RESULT: verified zero-axiom theorem NecessaryClassicalGodRootBoxK.boxKOfClassicalGodRoot (result f4395e76), registered as strengthens da3facd6 to cdf897a8 with a one-point strictness separator (result 4e83dbac: the box K node holds and the classical root fails when the supplied intellect predicate is empty). The proof only destructures the hypothesis and rebuilds the conclusion, so it is declared an assembly (transcription kind assembly), exactly like the sibling projections 822de823 and 0e932825 from the same node. COMPUTED EFFECT: none on route costs or closure. An assembly never expands a statement in the route-cost diagnostic and is not a support bundle; it closes cdf897a8 only if da3facd6 is closed (rule d), and da3facd6 is open. So the fork route still expands cdf897a8 through 0b9f4b1c with b9816722, cost 16 unchanged. FINDING 1 (the unpacked derivation already existed): cdf897a8 already has a verified non-transcription derivation a693bf86 from the same 25 quarta-via premises as the da3facd6 derivation 3a56507d. The route-cost rule picks, per statement, the proof with the smallest leaf union, and the packed bundle 0b9f4b1c (4 leaves: e068a626, 48366fb2, ab83e6d3, b9816722) beats every unpacked one. No added derivation of cdf897a8 or bed94ec2 from da3facd6 can change that: truth frontier --routes --frontier-root cdf897a8 gives 0b9f4b1c cost 4, the naming-node bundle 25135d6e cost 6 (its premise 8540b456 is derived only from cdf897a8 itself, by eceaaacc, so the bundle is cyclic in the full graph), the new projection cost 35 (the cheapest derivation of da3facd6, 379399d1, costs 35) and a693bf86 cost 43. FINDING 2 (size of the packing artifact, counterfactual diagnostic only): on main 6ecc2d87c with argument 0b9f4b1c and its result removed in a scratch copy, the fork route 8df2faad costs 55 (20 bare, 8 supported, 27 proved), and the cheapest route becomes 88671579 (from GOD_4 exists, cost 26). So the cost 16 is reached because one bare leaf, b9816722, stands for the whole support of the existence and attributes of GOD_4. This is a diagnostic comparison, not a cost reduction or a judgment about b9816722; b9816722 is a legitimate direct-assumption option and stays recorded as such. FINDING 3 (modal premises idle at the root step): catholicismFromIntendedReading (Results/Causality/NecessarySenseFork/Solution.lean) destructures the fork node bed94ec2 and uses only the witness g, IsGod g, IsTheOneGod and HasClassicalAttributes. The sense choice, its uniqueness, NecessaryIn and ActualRoot are discarded. So the five modal leaves of the route (T schema cb456382, IntendedIsBoxT 0aa36cd6, TheoryOnCone 48366fb2, ExistenceDictionary ab83e6d3, the stated-theory consequence e068a626) are needed to prove the fork node but carry no content into the root conclusion; the God content enters only through b9816722. Nothing was deleted. NEXT TEST: a computed view of premises that pack conjuncts of their argument's conclusion, and of premises whose content the root step discards (issue #1926 phase 4; a rule change needs an owner decision).
